body:
Member card of the skills catalog optimization program #14292 (maintainer mandate 2026-09-02, verbatim: 「审核所有的 skills，进行全面的优化。」). Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`). Read-only audit at objectstack `origin/main` a59f78d. The auditor's harness refused to write a findings file; the full findings are recorded in this card and in the audit-record comment the dev posts at claim time (copy of the seat's audit message, provided in the dispatch brief).

## Audit summary

`SKILL.md` 551 lines / **6,002 tok** (headroom 0) + generated `_index.md` 302; no `rules/`, no `evals/` (the only domain package without one). Heaviest sections: §5 `previous` vs `record` `:286-375` = 1,241 tok (20.7%); stdlib `:153-216` = 913; template surfaces + quickref = 511; cron surfaces + quickref = 228. Real usage: `P\`` 37 · `cel\`` 85 · `F\`` 0 · `cron\`` 0 · `tmpl\`` 0; top-5 tasks: seed dynamic dates (76, well covered), field conditional rules (63, roots incomplete), validation predicates (10, well covered), flow/trigger conditions (5, scope taught WRONG), date-macro filter tokens (21, zero mention). `type: 'formula'` fields: 0 live usages (the only hits are a removal test). Stdlib: 35 documented = 35 implemented (`CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS`), pinned one direction only. Verdict **DIET** (net −1,265 = −21.1%; structure sound).

## Flight constraints (binding)

- ONE draft PR, first line `Fixes #<this card>`; governed ⇒ stays draft; review requests are the seat's step.
- Token ratchet: `SKILL.md` may not grow; additions paid by deletions in the same file; ⛔ re-wrap is not payment; ⛔ no ceiling raise; ⛔ no new files; ⛔ do not touch the ratchet script.
- ⛔ Never edit another package's files or `skills/README.md` prose; follow-ups in the PR body. Generated files untouched.
- Live surface with zero measured usage ⇒ one row pointing at its schema; retired/tombstoned ⇒ delete. A false claim matching a spec `.describe()` string ⇒ spec-side twin card.
- Gates: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, plus `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`; record the head sha. Note: `packages/formula` pins the stdlib catalog ↔ skill in `cel-stdlib-drift.test.ts` and `skill-catalog-sync.test.ts` — run them.
- PR body: per-item 落点 | before | after keyed by finding id; token delta; `needs:contract-review` on both carriers (F-01, F-03, F-04 are contract-semantics claims).
